stages.detail: Cloud smoke3 completed. It used16,384 particles and the approved 0.04 m grid; box settlement occurred at 1.34 s.
At least 0 of 1,000 accepted episodes are visible in storage checkpoints. Worker states: {'RUNNING': 32}. Checkpoints lag active simulation by up to five minutes.
The pilot trainer writes checkpoints and held-out metrics. Full-dataset four-GPU training is prepared; no model accuracy claim yet.
Verified complete radius graph, remote-body isolation, training/inference parity, Warp state update, and a250-step held-out recording/evaluation run.

notes: The CLI submission response timed out, but a separate query confirmed the server started the job. It was not resubmitted.
Training will begin after collection metadata is checked for all 1,000 accepted episodes.
The local smoke checkpoint is only an implementation test; no trained-model accuracy result is claimed.
Raw recordings include settling, approximately 125 GB for 1,000 episodes based on the local pilot.
